result:
**Extracted claims:** 14 (6 tool-capability, 4 own-measurement, 3 number, 1 other). I checked 8 and dropped 6.

**Dropped (weight ≤2):** hook "~117 words" and the section word counts (L11, L99), the 7:46.5 runtime (L99), the "git deletes aren't destructive" aside (L55), the AiLORA "three files, one built" claim (L55, only a secondary receipt in `video_ideas.md:182`), and the "my memory index is one file, loaded every session" claim (L32).

**Verdicts**

| ID | Line | Claim (weight) | Verdict | Refuted? | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| C1 | 55 | "Claude only ever auto-loads CLAUDE.md itself, not a memory folder" (5) | Partly contradicted | n/a | Docs (code.claude.com/docs/en/memory): "Claude Code has two complementary memory systems. Both are loaded at the start of every conversation", with auto memory loading "first 200 lines or 25KB". Also loaded at launch: `.claude/rules/`, `CLAUDE.local.md`, and `AGENTS.md` (when no CLAUDE.md exists). A repo's own `memory/` folder is not auto-loaded, so the script's point holds, but "only ever" is wrong. |
| C2 | 43 | Anthropic's `claude-md-management` plugin has two tools, and "both add to CLAUDE.md. Neither one asks 'does this even belong here'" (5) | Partly supported | n/a | The local README (`~/.claude/plugins/.../claude-md-management/README.md`) lists the improver skill ("Keep CLAUDE.md aligned with codebase") and `/revise-claude-md` ("Capture session learnings"). Nothing in the README says they never prune or ask about belonging, so the "neither" half is the author's reading. I didn't read the skill body. |
| C3 | 43 | Anthropic "shipped a third one: slash checkup" that dedupes, splits into nested files, and cleans skills and MCPs (4) | Supported, but framing flagged | No | Boris Cherny's post (x.com/bcherny/status/2074997570317779038): "Dedup your local CLAUDE.md against the checked in CLAUDE.md… Break up root CLAUDE.md into nested CLAUDE.md's + skills… Clean up unused skills/MCPs/plugins." The repo's own `memory/video_ideas.md:227` says `/checkup` is "a registered alias for `/doctor`, not a separate command". |
| C4 | 43 | Cherny says to delete CLAUDE.md every few months and add back only what the model struggles with (4) | Supported | No | `memory/video_ideas.md:128` quotes the Threads post of 2026-01-06: "Try deleting your CLAUDE.md every 3 months. Then add back an instruction at a time when you see the model struggling with it." I did not open the Threads URL myself, so this relies on the repo's quote. |
| C5 | 55, 104 | Token drops of 6,080→912 (85%), 3,782→933 (75%), 2,338→1,820 (22%) (4) | Arithmetic supported, measurement unverifiable | n/a | The percentages check out (85.0%, 75.3%, 22.2%). `video_ideas.md:163` labels 6,080 as "(est.)". I found no raw token-count receipts. The AiLORA and faceless-yt files are outside this repo. |
| C6 | 21 | Brand hex values and the TTS voice lived "in exactly one place", the CLAUDE.md prose, and the memory files lacked them (4) | Mostly supported | n/a | `video_ideas.md:139`: the facts "exist only in CLAUDE.md prose — one incidental, non-indexed mention of the voice" sits in `pending_decisions.md`. So "exactly one place" is slightly off for the voice. |
| C7 | 74 | `/audit-claude-md` returned zero hits on AiLORA's original file despite real narrative (3) | Supported by repo notes only | n/a | `video_ideas.md:184` records zero hits and the missed phrases. I found no raw log. |
| C8 | 21 | The CLAUDE.md is "loaded into every single session" at 6,000 tokens (3) | Supported | No | Docs: CLAUDE.md files in the hierarchy above the working directory "are loaded at launch". That includes imports. Nested subdirectory files load on demand, which doesn't affect this root-file claim. |

**Flagged**
- **L55 (C1):** change "only ever auto-loads CLAUDE.md" to something like "doesn't auto-load your project's `memory/` folder". As written it contradicts the script's own L32 statement that a MEMORY.md index is loaded every session.
- **L43 (C3):** the script says Anthropic shipped "a third one" as a separate tool, but the repo's own research found it is an alias for `/doctor`. Also, "it reorganizes, it doesn't ask what belongs" was untested when written. The 2026-09-04 run found checks 2–4 had no findings on the already-lean file.
- **L21 (C6):** the "exactly one place" wording is slightly overstated for the voice.
- **L38:** the visual cue says to show a "What NOT to save" excerpt from `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`. The global CLAUDE.md in this session has no such section. That list comes from the memory-system instructions, so the on-screen "genuine proof" may not exist at that path.
- **Receipts:** the token counts (C5) and the zero-hits run (C7) have no raw logs in this repo. They rest on `video_ideas.md` prose.
